collection.name: Musée du quai Branly - Jacques Chirac

notes: 1. Construction note: Five markers are used on the quipu. The first three have the same colors and construction, the last two differ from these and from each other. 2. AS074-AS080 are associated. See AS074 for discussion. 3. By spacing, color pattern, and markers 1, 2, 3, the quipu is separated into 5 parts: Part I consists of 1 group of 7 pendants and Parts II, III, IV, V each consist of 8 groups of 5 or 6 pendants each. 4. The 32 groups of Parts II-V have the same color pattern: BS (if present), YB, YB, YB, MB, B. The first position (BS) never exists in Part V and sometimes exists in the other parts. 5. Some numerical consistencies appear on the quipu. (a) All values are 0-3 in Part II, 0-4 in Part III, and 0-5 in Part V. (b) In Part II, positions 5 and 6 are all zero-valued.
